question: For alien data, how many of the top 10 states by alien population have a higher percentage of friendly aliens than hostile aliens, with an average alien age exceeding 200?
sql:
WITH state_pop AS (
  SELECT state
  FROM alien_data
  GROUP BY state
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
state_stats AS (
  SELECT a.state,
         AVG(a.age) as avg_age,
         SUM(CASE WHEN a.aggressive = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as friendly_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN a.aggressive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hostile_count
  FROM alien_data a
  INNER JOIN state_pop sp ON a.state = sp.state
  GROUP BY a.state
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as result
FROM state_stats
WHERE friendly_count > hostile_count
  AND avg_age > 200
